cost_notes: Free of charge; a free account is required to mint the key.
free_tier: free API key after creating a USPTO developer account
historical_coverage: US applications and grants; dataset products from 2001 onward
known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09: /api/v1/patent/applications/search and /api/v1/datasets/products/... both returned HTTP 401 {"message":"Unauthorized"} - every data path needs X-API-KEY.
The portal absorbed the former developer.uspto.gov endpoints AND the PatentsView surface (see the patentsview record); counting them as independent sources double-counts one authority.
Assignee strings are as-filed legal names (subsidiaries included); ODP supplies no disambiguated assignee id comparable to PatentsView's assignee_id.
Patent family is not a first-class ODP concept; family reconstruction needs publication numbers or an external concordance (EPO/Google).
The docs UI is a single-page app; endpoint details must be read from its JS app or the linked API documentation, not from scraped HTML.
licence: US government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105)
research_value: The current US patent gateway and the practical replacement for the retired PatentsView API: free key, paged JSON, publication dates separate from filing dates. It is the only affordable way to get US pre-grant publications at record level for many thousands of assignees.
timestamp_fields: grantDate = later public-visibility event, not the earliest
